evidence_required: a one-page design with PCIe budget arithmetic, pinned-memory budget, NUMA placement, the overhead strategy with a rejected alternative, and a validation plan.

marking.criterion: PCIe budget arithmetic: 104,857,600 B / 60 ms = 1.75 GB/s per GPU (about 3.5 % of 50 GB/s), 3.5 GB/s per shared switch uplink
Pinned-memory budget (for example 3 × 100 MiB per rank = 2,400 MiB per node) and NUMA placement of ranks, loaders and buffers per socket
Optimizer overhead strategy (fused or foreach AdamW) defended against one rejected alternative (for example whole-step CUDA Graph)
Validation plan: nsys shows overlapped copies and few optimizer kernels; median step time over repeated runs vs the 60 ms target

title: Input and step-overhead strategy for HX8
